name: Motor-Driven Bicycle
description: A vehicle with two or three wheels, a steering handle, one or two saddle seats, pedals and a motor that can't propel it faster than 20 mph on a level surface, other than an electric assisted bicycle. The law counts it as a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels, a steering handle, one or two saddle seats, pedals, and a motor that can't propel it faster than 20 mph on a level surface
A pedaled e-bike with a motor over 750 watts that tops out at 20 mph lands here rather than in the electric assisted bicycle category
Named in the definition of motorcycle, so motorcycle rules apply
Riders need a driver's license with a motorcycle endorsement or motorcycle learner's permit
Riders and passengers must wear a safety helmet meeting FMVSS 218, with the retention strap secured
Titled and registered with the DMV like a motorcycle
